title: Flex-sensor sign-language glove: seven-sensor real-hardware data collection and machine-learning benchmark
description: Arduino firmware, data-collection protocol, preprocessing and a comprehensive machine-learning benchmark (linear, probabilistic, kernel, tree, bagging, boosting, neural, ensemble and deep temporal models, with statistical tests) for a seven-flex-sensor ASL fingerspelling glove (five finger sensors, an index-middle abduction sensor and an elbow sensor). Accompanies the IEEE PIC 2026 paper 'Enhancing Sign Language Communication Using Machine Learning and Smart Circuits'.
